findings.summary: First screen uses English index names and 'invest in the index' jargon; a deposits-only saver would leave right away.
The 2% inflation assumption is hidden behind a button; the main result only says 'in today's money'.
Monthly deposit box shows 750 but the slider appears to sit at 800, which is confusing.
Small grey text on a dark background, especially the lines under the big numbers, is hard for older eyes to read.
The 15-year cost bar uses similar colours and many small numbers; the big pink tax bar is alarming.
The main result does not warn that the assumed 7% growth could turn into losses.
The recommended securities account is Psagot rather than the reader's own bank, with no reason given to trust it.
